# Anuj Sadani

> Principal Software Development Engineer at Infrrd, based in Pune, India. Builds enterprise GenAI systems — RAG platforms, agentic workflows, evaluation pipelines — and leads the teams that build them. Owns the organisation-wide Python stack. Writes about AI engineering, infrastructure, and security.

Working principle: people, then business, then technology. Not a ranking of what is interesting, but an order of operations — when it inverts, something downstream breaks.

## Current role

- [Infrrd](https://www.infrrd.ai/): Principal Software Development Engineer, 2021–present. Architected the core GenAI and ML capabilities behind Infrrd's Leader placement in the Gartner Magic Quadrant. Owns the enterprise-wide Python stack. Designed a hybrid ML+AI system with 30–40% lower operating cost than an LLM-only implementation. Leads and mentors 12+ Python/ML engineers.

## Background

- Delivery Hero, Berlin: Software Engineer II, 2020. Python/Flask microservices for a high-traffic logistics platform.
- Nvidia, Pune: Senior Tools Development Engineer, 2009–2020. Led 8+ engineers on embedded automation frameworks and internal engineering tooling.
- B.E. Information Technology, Government College of Engineering, Amravati.
